text_en: Farm C grows lettuce, which is eaten raw. Tunisian rules forbid irrigating such crops with treated wastewater, so its share went to olive and cereal farms.
text_fr: La ferme C cultive de la laitue, consommee crue. La reglementation tunisienne interdit de l'irriguer avec des EUT ; sa part est allee aux oliveraies et cereales.
